steps.message: Turn on Wifi, then open the dialer app
Execute: adb shell "settings put global wifi_on 1"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "settings put global wifi_on 1""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -iE 'dialer|dial|call|phone'"
